newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle unevenly steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle unevenly steady - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Monday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers unevenly steady, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest mostly moderate. Offerings current.
